summary:
Radar for 2026-11-28, GLP-1 focus. Thanksgiving is over, so the holiday hook moves to Christmas (UK/AU first). Ranked by opportunity:

1. **Retatrutide vs Ozempic (TRANSCEND-T2D-2)** is the best fast-turn long video. It's a randomized head-to-head for a drug people search by name: A1C −2.2 vs −1.8 points, weight −20.9% vs −9.4% at 80 weeks, but more people stopped for side effects (7.9% vs 2.7%). Consumer outlets (ZME Science, Wisevoter, 11-27) picked it up a month after the topline result, and creators mostly cover it through gray-market 'reta' content. That makes it the closest match to the EloraTZP pattern. Caution: it's unapproved, so never mention or link any sources.
2. **The GLP-1 vision-loss warning** is a label-change story at its peak. Health Canada warned on 11-25 (CBC, CTV, Globe and Mail, 16 of 23 cases), after the FDA's class-wide label warning on 11-09. Angle: how rare it is, plus the same-day symptom, framed calmly around tirzepatide.
3. **Foundayo vs the Wegovy pill** is a head-to-head of the two approved pills. It's timely: the Wegovy pill reaches Australian pharmacies before Christmas, launches in Sweden on 12-24, and was approved by the TGA on 11-03. It feeds the Foundayo search engine.

After that come the evergreen felt-symptom formats the playbook says beat everything else: hair shedding, injection-site and pen moments, nausea, low blood sugar, feeling full after a few bites at Christmas. Then the Stopping/Keeping Results series, and lower-priority news (tirzepatide in type 1 diabetes, SOUL and Rybelsus, foods that raise your own GLP-1).

Rejected: the compounded orforglipron 'chocolate', 'cheapest tirzepatide online' lists, peptide patches, gray-market reta, the topiramate co-prescription paper (off-label combination dosing) and animal-only 'beats Wegovy' claims.

Duplicate check: Mounjaro vs Ozempic (SURPASS-2), Foundayo What to Expect, Vial vs Pen, Months 2–6, Kidney and Tirzepatide After 6 Months are already live or ready. Don't propose any of them again. The candidates below are built to sit next to them, not to repeat them.

Sources: https://www.hcplive.com/view/transcend-t2d-2-retatrutide-beats-semaglutide-2-mg-on-a1c-weight-loss · https://www.healio.com/news/endocrinology/20261113/retatrutide-confers-substantial-weight-loss-for-adults-with-obesity-type-2-diabetes · https://www.benefitsandpensionsmonitor.com/news/industry-news/us-fda-adds-the-glp-1-eye-risk-warning-canada-already-requires/394418 · https://thenightly.com.au/society/health/tga-approves-new-form-of-weightloss-medicine-wegovy-pill-with-daily-pill-set-to-be-available-before-christmas-c-23112105 · https://www.contemporarypediatrics.com/view/semaglutide-cuts-bmi-13-5-in-children-aged-6-to-11-with-obesity · https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12719702

candidates.topic: Retatrutide vs Ozempic: the Phase 3 head-to-head (TRANSCEND-T2D-2) in adults with type 2 diabetes, 80 weeks: A1C −2.2 vs −1.8 points, weight −20.9% (12 mg arm) vs −9.4%, more people stopped for side effects (7.9% vs 2.7%)
candidates.angle: Fast-turn long video titled on the result: 'Retatrutide vs Ozempic: What the Head-to-Head Showed'. Sentence 1 gives the result and the population (adults with type 2 diabetes, 80 weeks, vs semaglutide 2 mg). Payoff at 15–30 s: the trade-off, bigger loss but more people stopping, plus vomiting and diarrhea rates. Then TRIUMPH-2 vs placebo as a second chapter. End on 'not approved yet; Lilly plans to file in early 2027; until then the approved options are tirzepatide and semaglutide. Ask your prescriber what fits you.' Watch-next: Mounjaro vs Ozempic. Explicitly: 'anything sold as reta online is not this medicine.' No source names, no dosing talk beyond the arm labels the trial reports.
candidates.predicted_peak: 1–3 weeks (renewed consumer pickup 11-27; spikes again at the FDA filing in early 2027)
candidates.why_now: Consumer science and news outlets (ZME Science, Wisevoter, 11-27) are only now turning the 10-28 topline result and the Lancet TRIUMPH-2 paper into 'twice Ozempic' headlines. Daily Mail and Indian news coverage of gray-market 'reta' shows search demand is huge. Most of the YouTube supply is peptide or gray-market content, so a clean, trial-accurate explainer has little credible competition. A searched drug name plus a randomized result is our EloraTZP pattern (37% of watch time).

evidence.signal: Retatrutide beat semaglutide 2 mg on A1C and weight at 80 weeks; adverse-event discontinuation 4.8%/7.9% vs 2.7%
1,152 adults with T2D and BMI ≥27, 80 weeks vs placebo: −18.8% (treatment-regimen) at 12 mg; 3 confirmed pancreatitis cases
Consumer pickup: 'more than twice as much weight as Ozempic'
Mainstream framing: 'but more patients quit over side effects'

candidates.topic: GLP-1 vision-loss (NAION) warning: Health Canada's 11-25 warning on Ozempic, Wegovy and Rybelsus, after the FDA's class-wide label warning on 11-09 that also covers Mounjaro and Zepbound. How rare is it, and which symptom needs same-day care?
candidates.angle: Calm label-change explainer, drug first: 'Mounjaro (Tirzepatide) Vision Warning: How Rare Is It?' Sentence 1: it's very rare, and the one symptom to act on is sudden, painless loss of vision in one eye. Give both regulators' wording in their own words, the base-rate context, and who is at higher risk generally (for example, people with diabetes). Never 'stop your medicine': 'contact your clinician the same day.' Watch-next: Side Effects. Shorts: 'Blurry vision on Mounjaro: is this normal?' Common, temporary blurriness from blood-sugar shifts vs the rare red-flag symptom, all in one sentence.
candidates.predicted_peak: 0–5 days (Canada); US echo through the next label updates
candidates.why_now: Health Canada's warning ran in CBC, CTV, the Globe and Mail and Yahoo Canada on 11-25 to 11-27, and Bloomberg wrote 'now the drugs will have a warning label'. That's a high-CPM audience (CA/US) searching right now. Our NAION TikTok did 654. Coverage is mostly news clips, few calm patient explainers.

evidence.signal: Health Canada issues warning on rare risk of vision loss with semaglutide
US FDA adds the GLP-1 eye-risk warning Canada already requires
Rare eye condition prompts new FDA warning on popular GLP-1 drugs (11-10)
Review flagged 16 of 23 cases

candidates.topic: Foundayo vs the Wegovy pill: how the two approved GLP-1 pills differ (food and water rules, room-temperature storage, each trial's average result against its own placebo), as the Wegovy pill reaches Australia before Christmas and Sweden on 12-24
candidates.angle: Approved-pill head-to-head, title 'Foundayo vs Wegovy Pill: Which Fits Your Morning?' Sentence 1: the biggest difference you'll feel is the routine. The Wegovy pill is taken on an empty stomach with a sip of water and a wait before eating; Foundayo can be taken any time, with or without food (each per its label). Results: each against its own placebo, never compared directly, and no head-to-head trial exists. Watch-next: Foundayo What to Expect (ssb7Zcs3KSY). Shorts: 'Took my Foundayo after breakfast: is that okay?' (label relief fact).
candidates.predicted_peak: 1–4 weeks (AU pharmacy arrival before Christmas; Sweden launch 12-24; New Year's resolution searches)
candidates.why_now: TGA approval (11-03), and The Australian (11-27) ran 'Men squirm: Wegovy pill targets needle-shy men'. The Sweden launch date hit Reuters on 11-27. Foundayo is approved in AU, CA and the UK, so the 'which pill' question is live in three high-CPM markets. The competition is mostly telehealth seller blogs, not neutral video.

evidence.signal: TGA approves Wegovy pill, set to be available before Christmas
Novo to launch Wegovy pill in Sweden on December 24
Existing comparison coverage (articles, little neutral video)
Regulatory document to source the AU label facts

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide hair shedding: 'Is this normal?' (label 5.4% vs 0.9%; more often reported in women) and whether it grows back
candidates.angle: Short with the visible moment: hair in the brush or shower drain, the relief fact in the same sentence ('It's a known, usually temporary shedding linked to fast weight loss'), and the payoff in sentence 2 with no source opener. Protein and gentle care tips. Log the target: Hair Loss (retitled 'Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) Hair Loss: Why More in Women?').
keywords: does hair grow back after mounjaro
candidates.predicted_peak: evergreen; New Year starters push it higher from January
candidates.why_now: Hair is our biggest Short (1,036) and has stayed in the radar for 8 snapshots. Felt-symptom search is the proven format. More people start in December and January, so the 3–4-month shedding window means new searchers keep arriving.

evidence.signal: Hair Short 1,036 views (best 'Is this normal?' Short)
GLP-1 therapies need nutritional support beyond weight loss (protein and nutrient hook)

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide injection-site and pen moments: a red spot, itching, a small lump, a drop of blood, a bruise. Is this normal? (label: injection-site reactions 6–8% by dose vs about 2%)
candidates.angle: Shorts series, one moment per Short. Sentence 1 names tirzepatide plus the moment plus the relief fact; sentence 2 gives the plain payoff (common, and usually fades in days). Then one Instructions-for-Use tip (rotate sites, press and hold for up to 10 seconds). One red flag: spreading redness or swelling of the face or lips means get care. Target: Pen how-to (retitled 'Mounjaro Pen: How to Use It, Step by Step').
candidates.why_now: This is the proven Short format (n≈27): injection site 285 and 217, pen blood 185 YouTube and 1,775 TikTok, dropped pen 195, bruise 118. On Facebook, the injection-site reel got 10 shares. Device how-tos beat channel averages 10–195× in this niche.

evidence.signal: Pen blood Short: 1,775 TikTok views; injection-site reel 10 shares on Facebook
Label-based answers on tirzepatide use

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide nausea: why it happens, when it usually eases (the label: mostly during dose escalation, decreasing over time) and what may help, refreshed by HCPLive's expert GI-management interview with Michael Camilleri, MD (11-26)
candidates.angle: Felt-symptom Short: 'Nauseous the day after your Mounjaro shot? It's common, and for most people it fades.' Sentence 2: smaller meals, stop at 'just satisfied', go easy on greasy food. One red flag: severe stomach pain that doesn't go away, or vomiting you can't keep fluids down, means call. Target: Side Effects. Don't make a new single-symptom long video; this goes into Shorts and chapters.
keywords: what to eat when nauseous on mounjaro
candidates.why_now: HCPLive published both a GI-management interview and an observational piece ('GI symptoms affect an estimated 53% within 5 years') this week. Nausea is a top searched felt symptom, and the Foundayo nausea Short hit 857.

evidence.signal: Managing GI adverse effects of GLP-1 RAs, with Michael Camilleri, MD
GI adverse events rise with dose and formulation for semaglutide (supporting fact only)

candidates.topic: Christmas on tirzepatide: full after a few bites, rich food and heartburn, party drinks, and feeling queasy the morning after (UK/AU-weighted, from 28 Nov)
candidates.angle: Shorts only (the seasonal long video didn't pay). Each one is a felt moment: 'Full after three bites of Christmas dinner on Mounjaro: is that normal?', 'Heartburn after mince pies on Mounjaro'. The relief fact goes in sentence 1, then one practical tip. Never 'save up' or skip meals (no extreme-diet framing). Targets: Side Effects; Foundayo variants → ssb7Zcs3KSY.
candidates.why_now: The holiday-plus-felt-symptom pattern worked for Thanksgiving: full the morning after 502, stuffing 312, stomach pain 274, Foundayo Thanksgiving 1,063. The UK and AU are major Mounjaro markets, and Christmas search ramps from early December.

evidence.signal: 'As GLP-1 use grows, patients and doctors rethink Thanksgiving dinner' shows holiday-meal demand
Nutritionist on navigating holiday meals on a GLP-1

candidates.topic: Stopped Mounjaro: what happens next? SURMOUNT-4 (+14.0% regain on placebo, still 9.9% below baseline), refreshed by 11-26 coverage of weight regain after stopping incretins
candidates.angle: Broad Lane A follow-up in the Stopping → Keeping Results series, not a repeat: 'Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) Stopped: Does Food Noise Come Back?' Appetite and food noise after stopping, what SURMOUNT-4 showed, and the habits linked to keeping more of the result (protein, strength, sleep). Never advise stopping or switching. 'Plan any change with your prescriber.' It sits next to the big 'stopping Ozempic' videos in suggestions. Check the live list so it doesn't duplicate Stopping or Keeping Results.
keywords: what happens when you stop mounjaro
how to keep weight off after ozempic
candidates.why_now: Stopping is our proven grower (419 views, 663 min from suggested). This week Bioengineer ran 'Weight regain follows incretin cessation as cost limits long-term access', and InsuranceNewsNet reported that ending Medicaid coverage led to a sharp drop in GLP-1 use. More people will face this question in January.

evidence.signal: Weight regain follows incretin cessation
Ending Medicaid coverage linked to a sharp drop in GLP-1 use (context only, not the topic)

candidates.topic: Low blood sugar on Mounjaro: shaky, sweaty, dizzy. Is this low blood sugar, and who is at higher risk? (label: risk 'may be higher' with insulin or a sulfonylurea; also reported without type 2 diabetes)
candidates.angle: Felt-symptom Short with a long-video chapter. Sentence 1: 'Feeling shaky on Mounjaro? True lows are uncommon unless you also take insulin or a sulfonylurea.' Sentence 2: the signs to recognise, and checking if you have a meter. Never tell anyone to adjust diabetes medicines: 'your prescriber may review them.' Target: Side Effects.
candidates.why_now: Search-bait sites are publishing 'Mounjaro and low blood sugar' (11-27) and 'Does Mounjaro bring down blood sugar?' articles, which signals query volume. It's a felt symptom with a clear label answer and an underserved calm video explainer.

evidence.signal: 'Mounjaro and Low Blood Sugar: What You Need to Know' article published, showing search demand

candidates.topic: Mounjaro (tirzepatide) in type 1 diabetes: lower insulin needs? A small 12-week randomized pilot (22 adults with T1D and BMI >30: total daily insulin −35.1% vs placebo) and a new review, now in NewsNation/Yahoo (11-27). Not an approved use.
candidates.angle: Long-video chapter or explainer framed carefully: 'Zepbound in Type 1 Diabetes: What the Early Trials Show'. Sentence 1: early, small trials suggest lower insulin needs and weight loss, but tirzepatide isn't approved for type 1. Explain why insulin needs fall (weight and appetite), and why it needs bigger trials (low blood sugar, ketoacidosis watch). 'Never change insulin on your own; talk to your diabetes team.' No Shorts (news/study items underperform).
candidates.why_now: NewsNation and Yahoo Health (11-27) and a Bioengineer review summary appeared at the same time across mainstream and science press, with few creator videos. The T1D community is a large, searching audience.

evidence.signal: Zepbound may help lower insulin needs for type 1 diabetics
12-week RCT, 22 adults with T1D and obesity: insulin −35.1% vs placebo; no severe hypoglycemia or DKA
Tirzepatide is not indicated for type 1 diabetes

candidates.topic: Foods and habits that support your own GLP-1: protein, fibre, eating order, slower eating (The Independent's 'porridge to butter beans', 11-28; a gum-chewing crossover RCT)
candidates.angle: Broad 'natural ways' long video that corrects the hype: 'Foods That Boost GLP-1: Do They Work Like Ozempic?' Sentence 1: they nudge your own GLP-1 for a short while, but nowhere near the medicine's level. Then what's genuinely useful (protein first, fibre, eating slowly), on or off medication. Never 'replace your medicine'. Watch-next: What to Eat.
candidates.why_now: The Independent ran it on 11-28 and Nestlé/CBS 'GLP-1-friendly meals' stories ran 11-27. The 'nature's Ozempic' query family rises every January. Correcting a myth in a positive tone is a content pillar.

evidence.signal: Which foods mimic GLP-1s if you don't want to go on Ozempic (11-28)
Pre-meal gum chewing and postprandial glucose/GLP-1 responses

candidates.topic: Oral semaglutide (Rybelsus) and heart events: the SOUL trial (9,650 adults with type 2 diabetes plus ASCVD and/or CKD: first MACE 12.0% vs 13.8%, 14% lower risk), refreshed by a new total-events analysis (11-27)
candidates.angle: Chapter in a 'benefits beyond weight' long video, or one segment of the pills video: the pill form has its own heart-outcome evidence, in its exact population. Not for Shorts (study items underperform).
candidates.why_now: Managed Healthcare Executive (11-27) on total CV events. As the Wegovy pill rolls out, people will ask whether pills carry the heart benefit too.

evidence.source: Managed Healthcare Executive via Google News
evidence.signal: Oral semaglutide cuts total cardiovascular events in high-risk type 2 diabetes
Oral semaglutide significantly improves CV outcomes

candidates.topic: Protein when you're barely hungry on tirzepatide: hitting protein and key nutrients on small portions (news hook: food companies launching high-protein, smaller-portion GLP-1 products)
candidates.angle: A Lane A chapter, or a long video only if it doesn't duplicate What to Eat. Angle: 'Not Hungry on Mounjaro: How to Get Enough Protein'. A simple plate method, protein first, liquids that count. No brand or grocery promotion. Shorts version: 'Only ate twice today on Mounjaro: is that okay?' Relief fact, then one protein tip.
candidates.why_now: CBS (Nestlé test kitchen) and cbs19 on GLP-1 products, and BW Healthcare on nutritional support (11-28). Strength (1,276) and What to Eat (1,266) are proven earners.

evidence.signal: Inside a Nestlé test kitchen making GLP-1-friendly meals
Quality of weight loss during liraglutide with structured exercise (supporting fact)

candidates.topic: Semaglutide in children 6 to under 12 (STEP Young, NEJM 11-16; Nat Med commentary 11-25): BMI −13.5% vs +2.7% at 68 weeks, 167 children
candidates.angle: Low priority for our adult audience. At most a parent-facing long-video chapter that's factual and non-promotional: 'what the trial showed, what it didn't, why decisions belong with a paediatric team'. No Shorts, no 'game-changer' framing, no weight-shaming visuals.
candidates.why_now: Boston Globe, Becker's and The Limbic all covered it. It's peaking, and the audience fit is weak.

evidence.signal: Semaglutide cuts BMI 13.5% in children 6–11
STEP Young commentary 11-25

candidates.topic: Pipeline head-to-heads 'beating' tirzepatide or semaglutide: BrightGene BGM0504 (China Phase 3, press release) and the CagriSema REDEFINE 2 glycaemic substudy (Lancet D&E, 11-25)
candidates.angle: Low priority. Mention at most as one 'what's coming' line in a pipeline roundup. A press-release head-to-head from China with little Western search demand doesn't fit the EloraTZP pattern. CagriSema only if an FDA decision lands.
candidates.why_now: PR Newswire (11-25) and Lancet D&E (11-25). Search volume is low and the evidence is company-reported.

evidence.signal: BGM0504 outperforms tirzepatide in glucose lowering (company release)
CagriSema REDEFINE 2 glycaemic substudy

candidates.topic: REJECT: compounded orforglipron 'chocolate Melt' squares (Journi Health); 'Cheapest Tirzepatide Online' price lists; GLP North 'Retaject' reviews; needle-free tirzepatide 'patches'; gray-market reta exposés as a topic; the topiramate + semaglutide co-prescription paper; Tencent 'beats Wegovy' animal data
candidates.angle: Don't cover any of these. They promote compounded, unapproved or online no-prescription sources, imply off-label combination dosing, or present animal data as a human result. If a viewer asks, the only line is: 'Only use medicines prescribed for you and dispensed by a licensed pharmacy.'
candidates.why_now: These are trending in the feeds (Daily Mail, inkl, TMX Newsfile, iDiva), but they break the 'never cover' list.

evidence.signal: Journi Health sells unapproved compounded GLP-1 chocolate containing the Foundayo ingredient
Co-prescription of topiramate with semaglutide (off-label combination)
